query:
UPDATE interviews
           SET status = $3,
               started_at = CASE WHEN $3 = 'live' AND started_at IS NULL THEN now() ELSE started_at END,
               ended_at   = CASE WHEN $3 = 'ended' THEN now() ELSE ended_at END,
               updated_at = now()
           WHERE id = $1 AND interviewer_id = $2
